the civil war
The [American Civil War](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAVm0u5Rb9WI4xc1fhxvWFGogqGmGf-CLS5E3SQIKy97BVIjJH8hyR-lF2TlUxNJ6PpwGHDtQev5_xUTtRZHYoOmd__5owpnzRIGGQXTPwhK5oftzOT0U33YzPxmy0tEGf4YMW8) was a four-year conflict fought from 1861 to 1865 between the United States (the Union) and 11 Southern states that seceded to form the Confederate States of America. [[1], [2]]
Overview and Causes

* Central Issue: The war was fought primarily over the institution of slavery and its expansion. [1]
* Secession: Following the 1860 election of antislavery candidate Abraham Lincoln, Southern states seceded to protect and preserve chattel slavery. [[1], [2], [3]]
* Combatants: Roughly 2.1 million troops fought for the Union and 800,000 to 900,000 for the Confederacy. [1]

Key Dates and Battles

* Start Date: April 12, 1861, marked by the Confederate attack on Fort Sumter. [[1], [2]]
* First Battle of Bull Run (1861): Showed both sides that the conflict would be long and bloody. [1]
* Battle of Antietam (1862): The deadliest one-day battle in American history; it led to the [Emancipation Proclamation](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHrOzAV2ZdOXax9Zo9U5q0NThQnNoAsHpJwfmKvWeR_4i0cAk05ThRehsgU1pOvLvRbrAouDDaM-U6Y0I1rzYjkk9OXJHsPO8INuPUohEPmsIXo2gNF7qvwx7TlL4eogoJybnBTbclbOQ). [1]
* Battle of Gettysburg (1863): A major turning point that shifted momentum to the Union. [1]
* End Date: April and May 1865, concluding with Confederate surrenders.

Outcomes

* Preservation of the Union: The federal government defeated the rebellion.
* Abolition of Slavery: The 13th Amendment and Union victory freed four million enslaved African Americans.
* Casualties: The war resulted in an estimated 1.5 million total casualties and immense physical and economic devastation, particularly in the South. [[1], [2]]
